name: Luleå University of Technology
summary: Technical university in Luleå; five English bachelor's: three games and graphics degrees in Skellefteå, music in Piteå, mineral engineering in Luleå.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: January round opens (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
January round closes, all five programmes (not for final-year IB students)
January round: documents and proof of EU/EEA citizenship due

programmes.name: Computer Game Development and Programming
programmes.ib: Maths AI SL at 4, AA SL at 3, or AA/AI HL at 3. 10 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor Programme in Computer Graphics for Games and Film
programmes.ib: Any IB Maths course (AI SL at grade 3 is enough). 10 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor Programme in Computer Game Design
programmes.ib: Any IB Maths course (AI SL at grade 3 is enough). New for 2027; 10 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor Programme in Mineral Resource Engineering
programmes.ib: Physics and Chemistry at grade 4 (3 at HL), plus Maths AA SL at 4 or AA/AI HL at 3. 10 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor Programme in Music (Classical Musician, Composition, Church Music)
programmes.ib: An audition with a music theory exam decides; IB grades do not rank you. LTU says these three tracks are taught in English and Swedish. 2027 audition dates not yet published.

notes: LTU says final-year EU/EEA students must apply in the April round, but no LTU programme has an April 2027 round yet: as a May 2027 IB candidate you cannot apply yet.
In 2026 the games, graphics and mineral programmes were also open in the April round with 10 to 20 places, so an April 2027 round may still be added.
LTU's other Music tracks (jazz, rock, session musician, production and songwriting) are taught in Swedish.
